messages:
alex_support: Customer says Console shows 1,200 trial credits but API usage/billing endpoints return 0 — they claim tokens are being billed to a paid plan. Account snippet: org_id=org_9X7, account_id=acct_019. Attaching repro steps and API snippets.

alex_support: curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-abc..." "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/usage?org=org_9X7"
Response: {"total_tokens":0,"credits_applied":0,"billing_plan":"payg"}

alex_support: Console screenshot (attached) shows "Trial credits — 1,200 remaining". Customer asserts they sent generation requests and saw successful 200 responses from model endpoint. Provided request IDs.

sarah_support: any chance they created multiple orgs? common source of this.

maria_billing: can you paste request IDs and exact timestamps? Also include the API key prefix if they can (sk-***). Need to check key->org mapping.

alex_support: request ids: r_20240315_1012_az, r_20240315_1014_bx, r_20240315_1019_cf. Timestamps: 2024-03-15T10:12:03Z, 2024-03-15T10:14:27Z, 2024-03-15T10:19:41Z. Key prefix reported: sk-prod-abc.

tim_devex: :eyes: If the API key is scoped to a different org than the one the user is viewing in Console, the console will still show their trial for org_9X7 while requests go to org_9Y8. Can we confirm key->org from the key-store?

carlos_sre: pulling logs now. Please provide x-redwood-correlation header or the request_id from the payload so I can trace backend flow.

alex_support: headers from one call: x-redwood-correlation: cor_55d1, request_id: r_20240315_1014_bx. They also mentioned a transient "401: insufficient scope" on one call before switching keys, but later calls returned 200.

maria_billing: checking billing-service for acct_019... will post findings.

billing-bot: [billing sync job] Completed reconciliation for acct_019 at 2024-03-15T11:00:00Z — trial_applied=false

maria_billing: quick summary: trial grant exists for org_9X7 (console view). The API key used (sk-prod-abc) maps to org_9Y8 in our key-store. Requests were billed under org_9Y8 which has no trial grant, hence usage shows as payg.

maria_billing: Recommendation for customer: rotate/regenerate an API key while scoped to org_9X7, or switch the request's org param to org_9X7. For us: consider adding an explicit "key org" indicator in the Console API-keys page to prevent this confusion. :warning:

alex_support: relayed to customer. They confirmed they have two orgs and will generate a new key under the org that has the trial and re-test.

tim_devex: follow-up action — I'll add a small devex doc blurb "Troubleshooting: Console shows credits but API usage is billed" and a PR to show key->org mapping in Console.

alex_support: great, marking as resolved pending customer verification. Will reopen if they still see mismatch. :white_check_mark:
